description: Postal codes for 70 countries (GeoNames via zippopotam.us): postal code to place names, state and coordinates, or city + state to all its postal codes. For GB, CA and IE only the outward part (e.g. SW1A) is resolved. Params: country (ISO2, required), postal_code, or city + state (state abbreviation, e.g. CA, BY). Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"country":"DE","postal_code":"80331"}.
name: postal_code
title: Postal Code Lookup
